Synthesis:
Verified: retire() sets retiring without checking pins/roots, allowing zombie objects. validate() ignores handle generation vs epoch. No write enforcement despite "read-only" claim.
Hypotheses disproven: Generation numbers prevent stale access (false). External pin management is sufficient (fragile).
Test: Publish object → admit contract (pin) → retire → reclaim without dropping pins. Expect RuntimeError, confirming incomplete retirement protocol.
